item.title: Flight disruptions and cancellations loom as Icelandair faces shutdown over mechanics strike
item.description: Iceland’s national carrier has reportedly rejected an offer from mechanics, paving the way for a possible work stoppage that could begin soon. Iceland’s national airline carrier, Icelandair, reportedly rejected an offer from aircraft mechanics on Tuesday, paving the way for a potential indefinite strike—starting on Wednesday, September 23—if the two parties don’t reach an agreement by midnight local time on Tuesday, or 8:00 p.m. EDT....
